completiontracker.hint.blasting: Smelt it in a blast furnace.
completiontracker.hint.crafting: Craft it at a crafting table.
completiontracker.hint.disc: Have a skeleton shoot a creeper, or look in structure chests.
completiontracker.hint.drop: Dropped by mobs, found in chests, or traded.
completiontracker.hint.item.beacon: Needs a nether star from the Wither.
completiontracker.hint.item.blue_ice: Icebergs in frozen oceans, needs Silk Touch.
completiontracker.hint.item.breeze_rod: Dropped by breezes in trial chambers.
completiontracker.hint.item.conduit: Needs a heart of the sea and nautilus shells.
completiontracker.hint.item.creeper_head: A charged creeper must blow up a creeper.
completiontracker.hint.item.dragon_breat: Collect the dragon's breath attack with a glass bottle.
completiontracker.hint.item.dragon_egg: Appears on the exit portal after the first dragon fight. Break it with a piston or the torch trick.
completiontracker.hint.item.dragon_head: On the bow of end ships near end cities.
completiontracker.hint.item.elytra: In end ships near some end cities.
completiontracker.hint.item.enchanted_bo: Enchanting table, librarian trades, fishing and chests.
completiontracker.hint.item.enchanted_go: Cannot be crafted. Only in chests of bastions, ruined portals, ancient cities and desert pyramids.
completiontracker.hint.item.end_crystal: Craft with a ghast tear, eye of ender and glass.
completiontracker.hint.item.goat_horn: Goats ramming into stone, logs or ore drop horns.
completiontracker.hint.item.heart_of_the: Buried treasure; maps are in shipwrecks and ocean ruins.
completiontracker.hint.item.heavy_core: Rare reward from an ominous vault in trial chambers.
completiontracker.hint.item.mojang_banne: Craft from an enchanted golden apple and paper.
completiontracker.hint.item.music_disc_5: Craft from nine disc fragments found in ancient cities.
completiontracker.hint.item.music_disc_o: Chests in strongholds and ancient cities.
completiontracker.hint.item.music_disc_r: Brush suspicious gravel in trail ruins.
completiontracker.hint.item.nautilus_she: Fishing treasure, wandering trader, or drowned holding one.
completiontracker.hint.item.piglin_head: A charged creeper must blow up a piglin.
completiontracker.hint.item.recovery_com: Craft with echo shards from ancient cities.
completiontracker.hint.item.shulker_shel: Dropped by shulkers in end cities.
completiontracker.hint.item.skeleton_sku: A charged creeper must blow up a skeleton.
completiontracker.hint.item.sniffer_egg: Brush suspicious sand in warm ocean ruins.
completiontracker.hint.item.sponge: Dropped by elder guardians or found in monument rooms.
completiontracker.hint.item.trial_key: Dropped by trial spawners after a wave is defeated.
completiontracker.hint.item.trident: Rare drop from drowned holding a trident.
completiontracker.hint.item.turtle_scute: Baby turtles drop them when they grow up.
completiontracker.hint.item.wither_skele: Rare drop from wither skeletons; Looting helps.
completiontracker.hint.item.zombie_head: A charged creeper must blow up a zombie.
completiontracker.hint.mob.copper_golem: Build it from a copper block and a carved pumpkin.
completiontracker.hint.mob.creaking: Pale garden at night. Destroy its heart.
completiontracker.hint.mob.ender_dragon: In the End. Destroy the end crystals on the obsidian pillars first.
completiontracker.hint.mob.endermite: Sometimes appears when you throw ender pearls.
completiontracker.hint.mob.happy_ghast: Put a dried ghast in water and raise it.
completiontracker.hint.mob.mule: Breed a horse with a donkey.
completiontracker.hint.mob.piglin_brute: Bastion remnants; they do not respawn.
completiontracker.hint.mob.shulker: End cities in the outer End.
completiontracker.hint.mob.snow_golem: Two snow blocks and a carved pumpkin.
completiontracker.hint.mob.tadpole: Breed frogs; the spawn hatches in water.
completiontracker.hint.mob.warden: Deep dark; appears after a sculk shrieker is triggered three times.
completiontracker.hint.mob.wither: Summon it yourself: 4 soul sand and 3 wither skeleton skulls.
completiontracker.hint.mob.zoglin: Bring a hoglin into the Overworld.
completiontracker.hint.mob.zombie_horse: Spawns at night with a rider.
completiontracker.hint.mob_hostile: Spawns in the right biomes or at night.
completiontracker.hint.mob_neutral: Spawns in the right biomes; only attacks when provoked.
completiontracker.hint.natural: Found naturally in the world. Mine it with the right tool; some blocks need Silk Touch.
completiontracker.hint.sherd: Brush suspicious sand or gravel in ruins and trail ruins.
completiontracker.hint.smithing: Upgrade it at a smithing table.
completiontracker.hint.trim: Found in structure chests (each template in a different structure). Duplicate with diamonds.
completiontracker.no_data: No data yet. The tracker currently works in single player only.
